task.title: TG /vibecode: KHACH MOI bao 'khong the ket noi den may chu VPNFlow khi goi email login' — kiem tra gap
task.detail:
Nguyen van (bus #373, owner -> win, 2026-09-23T15:09Z):
KHACH MOI, LOI BAO KHONG THE ket noi den may chu vpnflow khi goi email login. Kiem tra gap.

Doi chieu ma loi trong client Windows: PrivateVPNWindows.Core/Api/ApiExceptions.cs -> 'Khong the ket noi toi may chu VPNFlow khi goi <endpoint>'.=> Loi mang/TLS phia client khi goi https://api.meetflowai.site (fallback https://t1.meetflowai.site).
task.verify: node ops/_scratch/verify-email-login.mjs -> (1) POST https://api.meetflowai.site/v1/auth/email/start {email:review@meetflowai.site} tra HTTP 202/200 + co debug_code (khong 500 'Failed to send login code email'); (2) POST /v1/auth/email/verify voi ma do tra 201 + access_token; (3) tren node-2: journalctl -u flowvpn-cp --since ... | grep '[otp] sent .* via resend' co dong moi va KHONG co 'sendOtpEmail failed' cho email that; (4) GET https://api.meetflowai.site/v1/health -> 200 {"status":"ok"} do duoc tu node Trung Quoc (node ops/_scratch/check-china-login.mjs)
